PROVED — WHAT RIDES ALONG IS A CARRIER. Callback gained `carry`: an optional (context) -> dict evaluated at FIRE time, merged over the static `body`, so a gate-watching callback can send the thing that crossed in whatever form the receiver can process. Akien 2026-07-25: 'a gate callback can say call dave back with "ticket detected at {gatename} as {ticket}" — whatever the callback can process in that location', and the payload need not be an artifact at all (the inference proxy's loop-count-over-N). Carriage is a CALLABLE, never a named kind — the same anti-reification the trigger already carries, one file up. by_pointer (the Law 6 default: only the address leaves) / by_copy (deep, so the receiver cannot reach back) / by_text (a format template) ship because they have consumers; a fourth carriage is a fourth function, not a schema change. Law 6 moves to the AUTHOR: sending owned data is now an explicit, greppable choice made in the owning device, exactly where the trigger's closure already puts it. A carrier that raises does NOT swallow the poke — it lands carrying carry_failed (Law 7, Akien's no-silent-failure rule). shim._fire posts cb.payload(context), so the bus's one producer now carries the moment, not the declaration.
note: The proof went red only in the SUITE (2 pokes, not 1) — the bus is durable via db_domain, so counting a live channel pinned a moving value. Fixed to the bus's own ephemeral-table pattern (nonce table + teardown); verified by running it twice.

standing: PROVED — A POKE PER CROSSING, NOT PER PULSE. Akien: 'so we need an anti-bounce?' Measured yes: on_pulse fired on the LEVEL, so a trigger parked true (a CPU at 91%) poked every pulse forever — the flood rackmount.py:129 filed as 'wants edge-detection' and left. Now the default is one poke at the crossing false->true, re-arming when the line is recrossed; Callback.while_true opts back into per-pulse for the watch that means 'keep telling me while this holds'. The DECLARATION is on the frozen Callback, the MEMORY is on the shim (_was_true, keyed by Callback.identity = to/channel/why) — the same declare/evaluate split the trigger already has, and the reason crossing-detection cannot live in callback.py. A raising trigger is remembered as NEITHER side of the line, so a swallowed error never also swallows the next real poke (Law 7); a vanished or re-established watch is forgotten rather than suppressed by stale memory; every held poke now says WHICH kind of held it is.
note: Named 'crossing', not 'edge' — 'filed edge' is already spent in this codebase on an open design question, and 'crossing' is already native (diagnostic.py's 'a boundary crossing', rackmount's {'crossed': value}). Coinage-by-selection, flagged for ratify. CHATTER (a value flapping across the line) is NOT cured by this and is deliberately NOT built — damping needs a measured width, and a wrong width silently eats real crossings. Filed with its opening condition on CairnCommons/tickets/bus-completion.json.

note: PROVED. WATCHME is physics at the one door: a node crossing forward out of a watch it carried must have EMITTED — the probe on disk, armed, its trigger/enough/carrier/nexus/consumer spec'd AT TICKETING. That inverts the LEARNME failure exactly: v1's summons sat in the backbone, mandatory for every node and gated by nothing, so it was crossed by every voyage and satisfied by none. WATCHME is OPTIONAL TO CARRY, MANDATORY TO SATISFY ONCE CARRIED, and 'none, because X' is the only other legal answer — silence is not. A probe carries no authority: it deposits and pokes, and probe.py cannot reach this chokepoint by any import or call, so the back-edge stays the owner's act (Law 6). WHAT THE VOYAGE ACTUALLY LEARNED, in the order it hurt. (1) The first live fire caught its builder twice where four green proofs had not: the corpus counted THIS ticket — the node that invented the mechanism, counting its own participation as evidence that authors participate — and `enough` had no sample floor while `_trigger` required 12, so the watch could CLEAR at n=1 but not FIRE until n=12. It was guaranteed to retire before it could ever bite: the v1 failure wearing this node's own clothes. (2) The rename falsified this ticket's own chart refs BY SUCCEEDING — the crossing was refused with five findings naming addresses piece (f) had renamed hours earlier — and the fix was a forwarding order on the record plus a both-ends filter, never editing the berths to match. H1 dies of this: in a system that checks refs in the world, no rename is behaviour-free, and an enumerated sweep list is a hypothesis about completeness, not a statement of it (bus-completion.json's live spec named three addresses the list never mentioned). (3) H4 dies of a sharper one: the skill-class precedent 'a version lands in the class file ALONE' did not transfer, because WATCHME roams and names its object and v1's fixed-position grammar could not express that. A precedent transfers on the shape of the CHANGE, not the shape of the artifact. (4) At this validate step the ticket's own falsifier clause (2) measured UNMET — a probe armed and never firing, with nothing loud about it — while this node's probe correctly HOLDS and will stand silent for many voyages. That is the LEARNME disease one level up, and the constrain berth's TEETH bound had named it and it was dropped between constrain and decompose. So it was built here, in bounds: a probe declares a `horizon` in PULSES (a clock is bounded OUT; the shim already counts pulses) and an armed-never-fired watch past it surfaces under its OWN key carrying its own numbers. WHAT IS OWED, named not glossed: nothing pulses this shim today (the wall-clock backing is a filed edge), so that loudness rides BaseShim.overdue() alone; _HORIZON=1000 is honest as a placeholder and dishonest as a measurement; build_inspector still stands at LEARNME under its own ticket and migrates on its next crossing, by its own owner; and test_needs.py is red for a PRE-EXISTING stage_needs two-vocabulary collision that needs Akien's ruling.
